parameters.description:
`msg-to-freemobile` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Free-Mobile destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional Free-Mobile destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"user":"${ customer_secrets.FREEMOBILE_USER }","pass":"${ customer_secrets.FREEMOBILE_PASSWORD }","msg":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="" and ": " or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Free-Mobile destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Free-Mobile SMS API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Free-Mobile destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

password_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Free-Mobile password
